REGISTRATION (SINDH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to amend the
Registration Act, 1908, in its application to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 12th May, 1997]
No.S.Legis.1(8)/97, dated 12‑5‑1997.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Registration (Sindh .Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force on
and from 29th March, 1997

Amendment of section 17 of Act XVI of 1908

REGISTRATION (SINDH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
REGISTRATION (SINDH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to amend the
Registration Act, 1908, in its application to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 12th May, 1997]
No.S.Legis.1(8)/97, dated 12‑5‑1997.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 17 of
Act XVI of 1908.‑‑‑In the Registration Act, 1908, in its
application to the Province of Sindh, in section 17, in subsection (1) in
clause (e) the colon at the end shall be replaced by a semi‑colon and
thereafter the following shall be added:‑‑
"(f) Power of attorney when
authorising the attorney to sell any immovable property;".
